It is understood that GROEHL @ RETZLAW proposes to remain in Saarbruecken, where he is now. He is said to be closely connected with the "Mouvement pour le rattachement de la Sarre" and is a regular contributor to its organ "Neue Saar".

Lt. Cmdr. Winston H. Scott, U.S.N.R.,
American Embassy,
71, Grosvenor Street,
London W.1.
